name: Alan Wilson
summary:
Alan McCrory Wilson (born Alan McCrory; July 16, 1973) is an American lawyer, politician, and military officer who is the governor-elect of South Carolina. A member of the Republican Party, he has served as the 51st attorney general of South Carolina since 2011.
The adopted son of U.S. Representative Joe Wilson, he attended Francis Marion University and the University of South Carolina School of Law.
